title: The Sunday Read: 'What I Learned When My Husband Got Coronavirus'

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是安德鲁·罗斯·索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for DealBook, a daily newsletter at the
sentences.zh: 我负责《纽约时报》每日简报 DealBook 的商业与政策报道。

sentences.en: New York Times.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市 DealBook 峰会的现场采访商界、政界和文化界一些极具影响力的领袖，包括 J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜

sentences.en: Lagarde, Zylran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the DealBook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 拉加德、齐尔兰·蒙达尼以及许多其他人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以实时观看其中一些毫无防备、未经滤镜的对话。

sentences.en: We're going to be live streaming select interviews for anyone to watch free at nytimes.com on
sentences.zh: 我们将对部分采访进行现场直播，任何人都可以于 11月18日

sentences.en: November 18th.
sentences.zh: 在 nytimes.com 免费观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅者，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序来观看，并免费获得我们所有新闻内容一个月的访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 我希望你能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.en: I'm Jake Silverstein.
sentences.zh: 我是杰克·西尔弗斯坦。

sentences.en: I'm the editor-in-chief of the New York Times magazine.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报杂志》的主编。

sentences.en: And for a couple of weeks now, we've been producing the magazine fully remotely.
sentences.zh: 过去几周里，我们一直在完全远程制作这本杂志。

sentences.en: You know, we're figuring out a way through it.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我们正在摸索应对的方法。

sentences.en: And part of what I think we're all learning is necessary as an office, as a group of colleagues, is that we're just much more involved in the
sentences.zh: 我想我们大家作为一个办公室、一群同事，都开始意识到一件事，那就是我们比以往任何时候都更加卷入彼此的

sentences.en: realities of each other's domestic lives than we ever were before.
sentences.zh: 家庭生活现实中。

sentences.en: We sort of see them happening in the background of our video calls when we're having meetings.
sentences.zh: 开会时，我们在视频通话的背景中多少能看到这些事情发生。

sentences.en: We're starting to get used to certain people popping in, you know.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我们开始习惯某些人突然出现。

sentences.en: Some people's kids pop in for technical support on some of the video calls now and again.
sentences.zh: 现在，有时有些人的孩子会为了寻求技术支持而突然出现在视频通话中。

sentences.en: And we're developing relationships with, you know, with kids and spouses and stuff like that.
sentences.zh: 我们正在与孩子们、配偶之类的人建立某种联系。

sentences.en: So around about the same time that we left the office and started working remotely, one of the two deputy editors of the magazine is Jessica Lustig.
sentences.zh: 因此，大约在我们离开办公室开始远程工作的同时，杂志的两位副主编之一杰西卡·勒斯蒂格出现了。

sentences.en: And Jessica's husband began having flu-like symptoms around that time.
sentences.zh: 大约在那时，杰西卡的丈夫开始出现类似流感的症状。

sentences.en: And they quickly got worse to the point that he was tested for COVID-19 and tested positive.
sentences.zh: 这些症状迅速恶化，以至于他接受了新冠病毒检测，结果呈阳性。

sentences.en: One of the things that Jessica started to say to us after about a week of living with this experience was that she felt she needed to write about it.
sentences.zh: 在经历这一切大约一周后，杰西卡开始对我们说的一件事是，她觉得自己需要把这段经历写下来。

sentences.en: Of course, when she said, I want to write something about this, I said, are you sure?
sentences.zh: 当然，当她说“我想写点关于这个的事”时，我说：“你确定吗？”

sentences.en: Just seems like a lot.
sentences.zh: 这似乎压力太大了。

sentences.en: And she said to me, I just feel like it's in me.
sentences.zh: 她对我说：“我只是觉得它憋在我心里。”

sentences.en: I feel like I have something that I need to tell people.
sentences.zh: “我觉得有些话我必须告诉大家。”

sentences.en: And to me, what's so unusual or complicated about this situation that we find ourselves in is that because we're all isolated from each other, we often don't really
sentences.zh: 对我来说，我们所处的这种状况如此不寻常或复杂的原因在于，由于我们都彼此隔离，我们往往并不真正

sentences.en: know how this thing looks when you get it.
sentences.zh: 知道当你感染这东西时它是什么样子。

sentences.en: And so I think Jessica realized that she was experiencing something that had clarified for her certain realities about COVID-19 and about what this
sentences.zh: 所以我想杰西卡意识到，她正在经历的一些事情让她对新冠病毒的某些现实有了清晰的认识，并且明白了这场

sentences.en: outbreak is going to be like for many, many, many people that hadn't yet reached the rest of us.
sentences.zh: 疫情对许多许多人来说会是什么样，而这些还没有波及我们其余的人。

sentences.en: So here's Jessica's story read by Julia Whelan.
sentences.zh: 这是由茱莉亚·韦兰朗读的杰西卡的故事。

sentences.en: It's called What I Learned When My Husband Got Sick with Coronavirus.
sentences.zh: 它名为《当我的丈夫感染冠状病毒时我学到了什么》。外

sentences.en: How are you doing, love?
sentences.zh: 亲爱的，你感觉怎么样？

sentences.en: I call to my husband from the living room floor, where I now sleep each night on
sentences.zh: 我从客厅的地板向我丈夫喊道，现在我每晚都睡在

sentences.en: a roll-up foam sleeping pad that my daughter has used on camping trips, topped with a couple of thin blankets.
sentences.zh: 一个我女儿去露营时用过的卷筒泡沫睡垫上，上面铺着几条薄毯子。

sentences.en: It's quite literally hard to sleep on the floor, but after trying the couch and then on the
sentences.zh: 睡在地板上简直可以说是难受，但试过沙发、接着又试了

sentences.en: floor the couch mattress, a bit of fabric stretched over some coiled rings, the floor itself has been a relief.
sentences.zh: 沙发床垫——一种绷在弹簧圈上的一点织物——之后，地板本身反倒成了一种解脱。

sentences.en: I need some help, he whispers hoarsely, shivering inside the wool undershirt and sweater he insists on wearing.
sentences.zh: “我需要一些帮助，”他声音沙哑地低语着，在坚持穿着的羊毛内衣和毛衣里瑟瑟发抖。

sentences.en: I didn't want to wake you.
sentences.zh: “我不想吵醒你的。”

sentences.en: I forgot to put the Advil in the plastic dish in the bathroom that is now his.
sentences.zh: “我忘了把止痛药放进浴室现在属于他的那个塑料小盘子里了。”

sentences.en: I can't leave the bottle in there.
sentences.zh: “我不能把药瓶留在那里。”

sentences.en: It has to stay uncontaminated in the other bathroom so that I can dispense the capsules into the dish and keep the bottle protected.
sentences.zh: 它必须完好无损地留在另一间浴室里，这样我才能把胶囊倒进盘子里，并保护好药瓶。

sentences.en: Anything my husband, T, touches has to stay in his room or be carefully taken from his room to the
sentences.zh: 我丈夫 T 触碰过的任何东西都必须留在他的房间里，或者小心翼翼地从他的房间拿到

sentences.en: kitchen, where I stand holding dishes while our 16-year-old daughter, CK, opens the dishwasher and pulls out the racks so I don't have to touch anything before she closes it again.
sentences.zh: 厨房。我站在那里手里拿着盘子，我们16岁的女儿 C.K. 打开洗碗机并拉出碗架，这样我在她重新关上洗碗机之前就不用触碰任何东西了。

sentences.en: She turns on the faucet for me, and I hit the soap dispenser with my elbow to wash my hands.
sentences.zh: 她帮我打开水龙头，我用手肘按压洗手液分配器来洗手。

sentences.en: My husband, a tall, robust
sentences.zh: 我丈夫是个身材高大、体格健壮的

sentences.en: 56-year-old who regularly goes, regularly went, on five-hour bike rides from our Brooklyn neighborhood
sentences.zh: 56岁男子，他过去常常——经常从我们布鲁克林的社区

sentences.en: to Jamaica Bay and Queens and back, has been lying on his back, staring at the ceiling or curled on his
sentences.zh: 骑自行车五个小时前往牙买加湾、皇后区然后返回，而现在他一直仰面躺着，盯着天花板，或者侧身蜷缩着，

sentences.en: side, wearing the same pajama bottoms for days because it is too hard to change out of them.
sentences.zh: 连续几天穿着同一条睡裤，因为换下它们实在是太难了。

sentences.en: Too hard to stay that long on his feet, too cold outside the sheets and blankets he huddles beneath.
sentences.zh: 要在双脚上站那么久太难了，离开他蜷缩其下的床单和毯子外面太冷了。

sentences.en: It has been 12 days since T woke up in the middle of the night on March 12th with chills.
sentences.zh: 自 T 在 3月12日半夜醒来并发冷以来，已经过去 12 天了。

sentences.en: The next day, just as reports were growing more urgent about the coronavirus spreading in the United
sentences.zh: 第二天，就在关于冠状病毒在美国传播的报道日益紧迫之际，

sentences.en: States, he thought he felt better.
sentences.zh: 他以为自己感觉好些了。

sentences.en: But then the chills came back, along with aches and a fever of
sentences.zh: 但接着发冷又回来了，伴随着酸痛和
100.4华氏度的发烧。

sentences.en: Since then, T has been confined alone in our bedroom at the front of the apartment, where he
sentences.zh: 从那时起，T 一直独自被隔离在我们公寓前部的卧室里，在那里

sentences.en: complains of hearing trucks idling at the curb just outside and long blasts from the ships in New York
sentences.zh: 他抱怨听到卡车在窗外的路边空转的声音，以及几条街之隔的纽约

sentences.en: Harbor a few blocks weSt. He creeps out only to go to the bathroom.
sentences.zh: 港船只发出的长鸣声。他只有去洗房时才会蹑手蹑脚地出来。

sentences.en: The bedroom door stays firmly shut to keep out the cat, who is determined to get in, and who howls outside it at night.
sentences.zh: 卧室的门紧闭着，以防猫进来——猫执意要进来，并在夜里在门外号叫。

sentences.en: What to do if you are sick with coronavirus disease 2019, reads the sheet T is handed at the
sentences.zh: “如果你感染了 2019 冠状病毒病该怎么办，”这是 T 的症状开始两天后

sentences.en: clinic two days after his symptoms begin.
sentences.zh: 在诊所递给他的纸上写的内容。

sentences.en: Separate yourself from other people and animals in your home.
sentences.zh: 将自己与家中的其他人及动物隔离。

sentences.en: By then, he has a fever of 101.5.
sentences.zh: 到那时，他的体温已经达到 101.5度。

sentences.en: He tests negative for the flu.
sentences.zh: 他的流感检测呈阴性。

sentences.en: Then, because he is considered high risk with what his medical chart calls severe asthma that sent him to the emergency
sentences.zh: 然后，由于他被视为高风险人群——他的病历显示他患有严重哮喘，几个月前曾因

sentences.en: room with an acute attack a few months ago, he is tested for COVID-19, the disease caused by the
sentences.zh: 急性发作被送往急诊室——他接受了 COVID-19（由冠状病毒引起的疾病）的检测，

sentences.en: coronavirus, just days before a national shortage of testing supplies emerged and the restrictions were tightened further.
sentences.zh: 就在全国检测物资短缺出现且限制进一步收紧的几天前。

sentences.en: Now we live in a world in which I have planned with his doctor which emergency room we should head to if T suddenly gets worse.
sentences.zh: 如今我们生活在一个这样的世界里：我已经和他的医生计划好，如果 T 的病情突然恶化，我们应该前往哪个急诊室。

sentences.en: A world in which I am suddenly afraid we won't have enough of the few things tempering the raging fever and soaking sweats and severe aches racking him.
sentences.zh: 在这个世界里，我突然害怕我们没有足够的药物来缓解折磨他的高烧、湿透的盗汗和剧烈的酸痛。

sentences.en: The Advil and Tylenol that the doctors advise us to layer, one after the other, and that I scroll through websites searching for, seeing out of stock again and again.
sentences.zh: 医生建议我们交替服用的 Advil 和 Tylenol，我一直在网页上反复搜索它们，却一次又一次看到缺货。

sentences.en: We are living inside the news stories of testing, quarantine, shortages, and the disease's progression.
sentences.zh: 我们生活在关于检测、隔离、短缺以及疾病进展的新闻报道之中。

sentences.en: A friend scours the nearby stores and drops off a bunch of bodega packets of Tylenol.
sentences.zh: 一位朋友在附近的商店搜寻，送来了一小包一小包的 Tylenol。

sentences.en: Another finds a bottle at a more remote pharmacy and drops it off.
sentences.zh: 另一个人在更远的一家药店找到了一瓶并送了过来。

sentences.en: A golden prize I treasure against the feverish nights to come.
sentences.zh: 这是一个金色的奖赏，我将用它来对抗即将到来发热的夜晚。

sentences.en: His doctor calls three days later to say the test is positive.
sentences.zh: 三天后，他的医生打电话说检测结果呈阳性。

sentences.en: I find T lying on his side, reading an article about the surge in confirmed cases in New York State.
sentences.zh: 我发现 T 侧躺着，正在阅读一篇关于纽约州确诊病例激增的文章。

sentences.en: He is reading stories of people being hospitalized, people being put on ventilators to breathe, people dying, sick with the same virus that is attacking him from the inside now.
sentences.zh: 他正在阅读关于人们住院、人们插呼吸机呼吸、人们死亡的故事——他们感染了同一种现在正从内部攻击他的病毒。

sentences.en: CK and I had settled in to watch Chernobyl, the HBO series about the 1986 nuclear accident and its aftermath, when T first felt sick and went to lie down in the bedroom.
sentences.zh: 当 T 第一次感到不适并去卧室躺下时，C.K. 和我正安顿下来观看《切尔诺贝利》，这部关于 1986年核事故及其后果的 HBO 剧集。

sentences.en: We stopped after three episodes.
sentences.zh: 我们看了三集就停下来了。

sentences.en: That time, when we would sit on the couch watching something together, is behind us.
sentences.zh: 那种我们坐在一起在沙发上看节目的时光已经一去不复返了。

sentences.en: Now, there is too much rushing back and forth, making sure T has a little dinner, just a tiny bowl of soup, just an appetizer, really, that he is unable
sentences.zh: 现在，有太多的来回奔忙：确保 T 有一点晚饭，只是一小碗汤，真的只是一份开胃菜，但他无法

sentences.en: to smell, that he fights nausea to choke down.
sentences.zh: 闻到气味，他强忍着恶心才能勉强咽下去。

sentences.en: Taking his temperature, monitoring his oxygen saturation levels with the fingertip pulse oximeter brought by a friend from the drugstore on the doctor's advice,
sentences.zh: 量体温，用朋友遵医嘱从药店带来的指尖血氧仪监测血氧饱和度水平，

sentences.en: taking him tea, dispensing his meds, washing my hands over and over, texting the doctor to say
sentences.zh: 给他端茶，发药，一遍又一遍地洗手，给医生发短信说

sentences.en: tea is worse again, standing next to him while he coughs into the covers, rubbing his knees through the blankets.
sentences.zh: T 的病情又加重了，当他在被子里咳嗽时站在他旁边，隔着毯子揉揉他的膝盖。

sentences.en: You shouldn't stay here, he says.
sentences.zh: “你不该留在这里，”他说。

sentences.en: But he gets more frightened as night comes, dreading the long hours of fever and soaking sweats and shivering and terrible aches.
sentences.zh: 但随着夜幕降临，他变得更加害怕，恐惧着漫长的发烧、湿透的盗汗、瑟瑟发抖和可怕的酸痛。

sentences.en: This thing grinds you like a mortar, he says.
sentences.zh: “这东西把你像石臼一样碾碎，”他说。

sentences.en: C.K.'s high school, closed on March 13th, is now preparing with the rest of New York City's public schools to begin distance learning.
sentences.zh: C.K. 的高中于 3月13日关闭，现在正与纽约市其他公立学校一起准备开始远程教学。

sentences.en: For days, she and her classmates have received instructions about what to expect, turning administrator and
sentences.zh: 连日来，她和同学们一直在接收关于预期情况的指示，把管理员和

sentences.en: teacher directives into endless memes, feeds filling with repeated admonitions.
sentences.zh: 老师的指令变成无休止的表情包，动态消息里充满了重复的告诫。

sentences.en: This is regular school.
sentences.zh: 这是正常的学校。

sentences.en: This is not vacation.
sentences.zh: 这不是假期。

sentences.en: I start an email to her principal, guidance counselors, and teachers.
sentences.zh: 我开始给她所在的校长、辅导员和老师写一封电子邮件。

sentences.en: I am writing to let you know what C.K.
sentences.zh: 我写信是为了让你们知道 C.K.

sentences.en: has been going through at home.
sentences.zh: 在家里经历了什么。

sentences.en: The draft sits open all day.
sentences.zh: 这份草稿一整天都开着。

sentences.en: I am texting the doctor.
sentences.zh: 我在给医生发短信。

sentences.en: I am texting T's five siblings on a group chat, texting my parents and my brother, texting T's business partner and employees and his dearest friends and mine,
sentences.zh: 我在群聊里给 T 的五个兄弟姐妹发短信，给我的父母和兄弟发短信，给 T 的商业伙伴、员工以及他和我的最挚爱的朋友发短信，

sentences.en: in loops and loops with hearts and thankful prayer hands emoji.
sentences.zh: 一圈又一圈地发着，配上爱心和感谢祈祷的表情符号。

sentences.en: He is too exhausted, too weak to answer all the missives winging to him at all hours.
sentences.zh: 他太精疲力竭了，太虚弱了，无法回复全天候飞向他的所有信息。

sentences.en: Don't sugarcoat it for my family, he tells me.
sentences.zh: “不要对我的家人粉饰太平，”他对我说。

sentences.en: He has asked for the gray sweater that was his father's, that his father wore when he was alive.
sentences.zh: 他要了那件他父亲的灰色毛衣，那是他父亲生前穿过的毛衣。

sentences.en: He will not take it off.
sentences.zh: 他怎么也不肯脱下它。

sentences.en: It's as if we are in a time warp, in which we have accelerated at one and a half-time speed while everyone around us remains in the present, already the past to us.
sentences.zh: 就好像我们处于一个时间扭曲中，我们以一点五倍的速度加速，而我们周围的所有人仍然停留在现在，对我们而言这已经是过去。

sentences.en: And they, blissfully, unconsciously, go about their ordinary lives, experiencing the growing news,
sentences.zh: 而他们，幸福地、毫无觉察地过着他们平凡的生活，将不断增长的新闻、

sentences.en: the more urgent advisories and directives, as a vast communal experience, sharing posts and memes
sentences.zh: 更紧迫的建议和指令当作一种广泛的集体体验，分享着关于

sentences.en: about cabin fever, about homeschooling, about social distancing, about how hard it all is,
sentences.zh: 幽闭恐惧症、在家上学、保持社交距离以及这一切有多难的帖子和表情包，

sentences.en: while we're living in our makeshift sick ward, living in what will soon be the present for more and more of them.
sentences.zh: 而我们却住在我们拼凑的病房里，生活在很快将成为他们越来越多的人的现在之中。

sentences.en: I took out the kitty litter, CK says, and I saw some people standing on the corner, and I was like, I want to see strangers.
sentences.zh: “我倒了猫砂，”C.K. 说，“我看到几个人站在街角，我当时想，我想见见陌生人。”

sentences.en: And then I heard them saying, it's actually been really nice.
sentences.zh: “然后我听到他们说，‘其实真的挺好的。’‘这是一个作为家庭连接的机会。’”

sentences.en: It's been a chance to connect as a family.
sentences.zh: “然后我就想，‘不，其实我不想见陌生人。’”

sentences.en: And I was like, no, actually, I don't want to see strangers.
sentences.zh: “然后我又进来了。”

sentences.en: And I came back in.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》应用程序？

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 解锁了？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 众所周知，你需要订阅《时报》才能访问所有的报道。

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to the Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 但是，如果你可以免费探索《时报》一个月，而无需输入信用卡呢？

sentences.en: But what if you could explore the Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 当你首次下载《纽约时报》应用程序时，你在该应用程序中的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: When you download the New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 有一个月的时间可以突破付费墙，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能得到什么。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 如果你尚未订阅《纽约时报》，请立即下载《时报》应用程序，并获得 30 天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to the New York Times, download the Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: C.K. 和我把自己限制在半间浴室里，就是那个放着猫砂盆的浴室，现在由她负责清理。

sentences.en: CK and I confine ourselves to the half-bathroom, the one with the litter box which she is now in charge of.
sentences.zh: 在过去的日日夜夜里，那个有些飘忽、爱做白日梦的 C.K. 已经成了我护理、

sentences.en: Over the past days and days, drifty, dreamy CK has become my chief assistant on my nursing,
sentences.zh: 家务、厨房轮值的首席助手：喂猫、清理猫砂盆、叠衣服、

sentences.en: housekeeping, kitchen rotations, feeding the cat and cleaning the litter box, folding laundry,
sentences.zh: 准备茶的小份饭菜、洗碗和锅，当我拿着盘子走出病房时，与我进行复杂的

sentences.en: preparing tea's small meals, washing dishes and pots, coordinating with me in a complicated
sentences.zh: 编排配合，这样我们就能把盘子放进洗碗机，而我不用碰把手，也不必把我那干燥、生疼的手洗得更多。

sentences.en: choreography when I come out of the sick room holding dishes so we can get them into the dishwasher without my touching the handles or having to wash my dry, raw hands even more.
sentences.zh: “我觉得我们现在更像是以平等的方式在对话了，”她说。

sentences.en: I feel like we're talking to each other more like equals now, she says.
sentences.zh: 她说得对。

sentences.en: She is right.
sentences.zh: 我全神贯注于努力保证我们的安全。

sentences.en: I am consumed with trying to keep us safe.
sentences.zh: 我用消毒剂擦拭门把手、电灯开关、水龙头、拉手、柜台。

sentences.en: I wipe down the doorknobs, the light switches, the faucets, the handles, the counters with disinfectant.
sentences.zh: 我用酒精擦拭我的手机。

sentences.en: I swab my phone with alcohol.
sentences.zh: 我把当天的连帽衫扔进晚上的洗衣堆里，就像那是我的手术服一样。

sentences.en: I throw the day's hoodie into the laundry at night as if it were my scrubs.
sentences.zh: 我一遍又一遍地清洗我们所有的毛巾。

sentences.en: I wash all our towels again and again.
sentences.zh: 当 C.K. 想洗澡时，我用漂白剂擦拭 T 重新灌满水杯、他曾拉过肚子、他咳嗽并吐痰的整个主浴室。

sentences.en: When CK wants to shower, I wipe down the whole main bathroom where T refills his water cup, where he has had diarrhea, where he coughs and spits out phlegm with bleach.
sentences.zh: 拿走 T 的毛巾、浴巾和浴室地垫，换上干净的，告诉 C.K. 尽量不要碰任何东西，洗完澡直接回她的房间。

sentences.en: Take out T's washcloth, towels, and bath mat and replace them with clean ones, telling CK to try not to touch anything, to shower and go right back to her room.
sentences.zh: 然后我也照做。

sentences.en: Then I do the same.
sentences.zh: 如果 T 在我们准备洗澡之前需要使用浴室，我们在进去之前要再次进行整套漂白清洁程序。

sentences.en: If T needs to use the bathroom before we're ready to shower, I do the whole bleach routine again before we go in.
sentences.zh: 生病的第一周里有两次，我扶他泡了 Epsom 盐浴，但那之后就再也没有了。

sentences.en: Twice in the first week of the illness, I eased him into an Epsom salt bath, but not since then.
sentences.zh: 他太虚弱了。

sentences.en: He is too weak.
sentences.zh: 那会吃不消的。

sentences.en: It would be too much.
sentences.zh: 根本不可能。

sentences.en: There is no way.
sentences.zh: 当他从卧室沿着走廊挪到浴室时，他靠着墙壁摇摇晃晃。

sentences.en: When he shuffles down the hall from the bedroom to the bathroom, he lists against the wall.
sentences.zh: 他在浴室里用水泼了泼脸，这就够了。

sentences.en: He splashes water on his face in the bathroom, and that has to be enough.
sentences.zh: 我脑海中闪过各种可能性。

sentences.en: I run through possibilities.
sentences.zh: 我其实不那么担心 C.K. 生病。

sentences.en: I'm not so worried about CK getting sick.
sentences.zh: 我其实不那么担心 C.K. 生病。

sentences.en: I can nurse her too.
sentences.zh: 我也能照顾他。

sentences.en: It's if I get sick.
sentences.zh: 我是说万一我病倒了。

sentences.en: I show her how to do more things, where things go, what to remember, what to do if… What if T is hospitalized?
sentences.zh: 我教她怎么做更多的事，东西都放在哪，该记住什么，万一……万一T住院了怎么办？

sentences.en: What if I am?
sentences.zh: 万一我倒下了呢？

sentences.en: Could a 16-year-old be left to fend for herself at home, alone?
sentences.zh: 一个十六岁的孩子能独自留在家里自谋生路吗？

sentences.en: How would she get what she needed?
sentences.zh: 她怎么弄到需要的东西？

sentences.en: Could she do it?
sentences.zh: 她能做到吗？

sentences.en: For how long?
sentences.zh: 能撑多久？

sentences.en: The one thing I know is that I could not send her to my parents, 78 years old and nearby on Long Island.
sentences.zh: 我唯一确定的是，我不能把她送到我父母那里，他们已经七十八岁了，就住在长岛附近。

sentences.en: They would want her to come, but she could kill them, their dear grandchild coming forward to their embrace, radioactive, glowing with invisible, incubating virus cells.
sentences.zh: 他们会想让她过去，但她可能会害死他们，他们亲爱的孙女满怀爱意地迎上前去拥抱他们，却带着辐射，浑身闪烁着看不见的、正在潜伏的病毒细胞。

sentences.en: No, not them.
sentences.zh: 不，不能送去他们那。

sentences.en: Someone else would have to take her.
sentences.zh: 得让别人来带走她。

sentences.en: Someone who has a bedroom and a bathroom where she could isolate and be cared for.
sentences.zh: 一个有卧室和浴室，能让她隔离并得到照顾的人。

sentences.en: Someone would.
sentences.zh: 会有人愿意的。

sentences.en: I lie awake at 4 a.m.
sentences.zh: 我在凌晨四点醒着躺着。

sentences.en: on the floor, listening, thinking, wide awake with adrenaline.
sentences.zh: 躺在地板上，倾听着，思考着，肾上腺素飙升，毫无睡意。

sentences.en: The nights are hardest, when the fear and dread descend.
sentences.zh: 夜晚是最难熬的，恐惧和焦虑感在这个时候袭来。

sentences.en: T feverish, lying on his back, murmuring hoarsely about anime, saying he almost just called CK by the name of his 20 years ago ex-girlfriend.
sentences.zh: T发着烧，仰面躺着，沙哑地念叨着动漫，说他刚才差点把CK叫成他二十年前的前女友的名字。

sentences.en: Three times we have tried to decide whether we need to go to the emergency room while on speakerphone with the doctor.
sentences.zh: 我们开着免提和医生通话，已经三次试图决定是否需要去急诊室了。

sentences.en: Once, after I burst into sobs in the bathroom, saying out loud, I'm afraid to make the wrong call.
sentences.zh: 有一次，我在浴室里放声大哭，大声说着，我害怕做错了决定。

sentences.en: Each time, we decided to stay at home.
sentences.zh: 每一次，我们都决定留在家里。

sentences.en: He doesn't have trouble breathing, and that would be the reason to go to the hospital.
sentences.zh: 他呼吸没有困难，而这才是要去医院的理由。

sentences.en: We do a video call on one of these nights with a New York University emergency room doctor,
sentences.zh: 其中一个夜晚，我们和纽约大学的一位急诊室医生进行了视频通话，

sentences.en: one of 250 who have been mobilized to do urgent care video calls with patients who have flu-like symptoMs.
sentences.zh: 她是250名被动员的医生之一，负责为有流感样症状的患者提供紧急护理视频通话。

sentences.en: She tells us that they are seeing this illness run two to three weeks.
sentences.zh: 她告诉我们，这种病程一般会持续两到三周。

sentences.en: She tells us that T is okay to stay home if his oxygen saturation reading doesn't get too low, if he is not struggling to breathe.
sentences.zh: 她告诉我们，如果T的血氧饱和度没有降得太低，如果他没有呼吸困难，待在家里是可以的。

sentences.en: He is not.
sentences.zh: 他没有呼吸困难。

sentences.en: When I open the bedroom door to check on him and find him sleeping, I tiptoe closer and bend to make sure he is alive, to make sure he is still breathing,
sentences.zh: 当我打开卧室门去看看他、发现他在睡觉时，我蹑手蹑脚地走近，俯下身去确认他还活着，确认他还在呼吸，

sentences.en: as I used to do when CK was an infant asleep in her crib.
sentences.zh: 就像以前CK还是个在婴儿床里睡觉的婴儿时我做的那样。

sentences.en: On one of the worst nights, I stay next to the bed, rubbing his body through the piled-on blankets, trying to comfort him.
sentences.zh: 在最糟糕的一个夜晚，我一直待在床边，隔着厚厚的一叠毯子抚摸他的身体，试图安慰他。

sentences.en: I hear myself start to hum, lo, the only song I would, the song both my mother and my grandmother used to sing to me.
sentences.zh: 我听到自己哼唱起来，哦，唯一会唱的那首歌，我母亲和我外祖母以前都唱给我听的歌。

sentences.en: When my mother sang it, it was Tura Lura Lura, with When Irish Eyes Are Smiling cut into it after the words, That's an Irish Lullaby.
sentences.zh: 我母亲唱的时候，它是《特拉·鲁拉·鲁拉》，在唱完“那是首爱尔兰摇篮曲”这句歌词后，中间还夹着《当爱尔兰人的眼睛在微笑》。

sentences.en: When my grandmother sang it to me, it was Tura Lura Lura, with the words change to, That's a Russian Lullaby.
sentences.zh: 我外祖母唱给我听的时候，它是《特拉·鲁拉·鲁拉》，歌词改成了“那是首俄罗斯摇篮曲”。

sentences.en: That is the song of my early childhood, and more than four decades later, I am humming it to my gravely ill husband.
sentences.zh: 那是陪伴我童年早期的歌，而四十多年后，我正在把它哼唱给我病重垂危的丈夫听。

sentences.en: Now we live in a dystopian story, I say to CK in the kitchen.
sentences.zh: 现在我们活在了一个反乌托邦的故事里，我对厨房里的CK说。

sentences.en: Yeah, she says.
sentences.zh: 是啊，她说。

sentences.en: And then, lots of people already did.
sentences.zh: 接着又说，其实很多人早就活在其中了。

sentences.en: Out on the street, T somehow looks even more frail, his six-foot-one frame stooped and swaddled
sentences.zh: 走到街上，T看起来不知为何更加虚弱了，他六尺一寸的身躯佝偻着，裹得严严实实，

sentences.en: in his winter jacket, over another jacket, over his father's gray wool sweater, over a duo-fold wool undershirt, over a white-ribbed tank.
sentences.zh: 外面套着一件冬衣，里面还有一件夹克，再里面是他父亲的灰色羊毛衫，然后是一件双面织羊毛衬衫，最里面是一件白色罗纹背心。

sentences.en: He says it's cold, blinking in the March sun over the white surgical mask he wore at the clinic when he was tested.
sentences.zh: 他说好冷，在诊所做检测时戴着的那只白色外科口罩上方，在三月的阳光下眨着眼睛。

sentences.en: We both wear disposable gloves.
sentences.zh: 我们俩都戴着一次性手套。

sentences.en: I put my hand through the crook of his arm, and we slowly start for the clinic.
sentences.zh: 我把手挽进他手臂的臂弯里，我们慢慢动身去诊所。

sentences.en: The day before was one of the harder ones, with T lightheaded and nauseated most of the day, eating only if I spoon-fed him,
sentences.zh: 前一天是比较难熬的一天，T一整天都头晕恶心，只有我用勺子喂他才肯吃一点东西，

sentences.en: coughing more and using his albuterol inhaler more, then coughing more again.
sentences.zh: 咳嗽得更厉害了，沙丁胺醇吸入器用得也更频繁了，然后咳得更凶了。

sentences.en: He was soaked in sweat in the morning, and by evening was lying curled up, looking apprehensive.
sentences.zh: 他早上时汗流浃背，到了傍晚则蜷缩着躺在那里，神情惊恐。

sentences.en: I coughed up blood just now, he told me quietly.
sentences.zh: 我刚刚咳血了，他轻声对我说。

sentences.en: We talked to his doctor on speakerphone.
sentences.zh: 我们通过免提电话和他的医生交谈。

sentences.en: We are all kind of working blind, he told us.
sentences.zh: 我们现在有点像是在摸着石头过河，他对我们说。

sentences.en: Many patients, he said, seem to begin to feel better after a week.
sentences.zh: 他说，很多患者似乎在一周后开始感觉好转。

sentences.en: But others, the more serious and severe cases, take a downturn, and the risks rise as the virus targets the lungs.
sentences.zh: 但另一些人，那些更严重、更危急的病例，病情会急转直下，随着病毒攻击肺部，风险也随之上升。

sentences.en: Pneumonia is a common next step in that downward progression.
sentences.zh: 肺炎是这种病情恶化过程中常见的下一步。

sentences.en: We read about it in the patients admitted to the hospital.
sentences.zh: 我们在那些住进医院的患者身上读到了这种情况。

sentences.en: Now, the doctor called in a prescription for antibiotics to the CVS pharmacy that would close in less than an hour.
sentences.zh: 现在，医生给不到一个小时后就要关门的CVS药房打电话开好了抗生素处方。

sentences.en: I texted T's friend down the block, and he texted back that he would pick up the medicine.
sentences.zh: 我给街区那头的T的朋友发了条短信，他回短信说他去取药。

sentences.en: I asked if he would get oranges, too.
sentences.zh: 我问他能不能顺便买点橙子。

sentences.en: T has been accepting a little fresh-squeezed juice or cut-up pieces, and we were down to one last orange.
sentences.zh: T一直能吃下一点鲜榨果汁或切好的橙子块，而我们只剩最后一个橙子了。

sentences.en: They suddenly seemed an unimaginably exotic treat.
sentences.zh: 它们突然间成了想象不到的奢侈慰藉。

sentences.en: The doctor told us to go back to the clinic for chest x-rays first thing in the morning.
sentences.zh: 医生让我们一大早先回诊所拍胸片。

sentences.en: Now, we slowly walk the three blocks, T coughing behind his mask.
sentences.zh: 现在，我们慢慢地走过这三个街区，T戴着口罩在后面咳嗽。

sentences.en: As we move along the street, we see some other people, too, fewer than a few days ago, before Governor Andrew Cuomo directed New Yorkers to stay indoors as much as possible.
sentences.zh: 一路上，我们也看到了一些其他人，比几天前安德鲁·科莫州长指示纽约人尽量待在室内之前要少一些。

sentences.en: Some joggers go by.
sentences.zh: 几个慢跑的人从旁跑过。

sentences.en: Just over a week ago, that was still me.
sentences.zh: 就在一个多星期前，那还是我。

sentences.en: Now, I point out the buds about to bloom on the branches we pass, drawing T's attention away from the few passers-by so we won't see if they start or turn around.
sentences.zh: 现在，我指着路过树枝上含苞待放的花蕾，把T的注意力从仅有的几个路人身上引开，这样我们就不用去看他们是否会惊慌避开或转过身去了。

sentences.en: A few are wearing their own masks, but they are walking upright, striding along, using them as protection for themselves, not like us.
sentences.zh: 有几个人戴着他们自己的口罩，但他们昂首挺胸、大步流星地走着，把口罩当作保护自己的工具，不像我们。

sentences.en: At the clinic, another couple wearing masks opens the door and walks in.
sentences.zh: 到了诊所，另一对戴着口罩的夫妇推开门走了进去。

sentences.en: A man in a mask sits in the waiting area.
sentences.zh: 一个戴口罩的男人坐在候诊区里。

sentences.en: T eases into a chair and leans against the wall with his eyes closed.
sentences.zh: T放轻脚步坐进一把椅子里，闭着眼睛靠在墙上。

sentences.en: I go to the desk.
sentences.zh: 我走向服务台。

sentences.en: My husband has already tested positive for COVID-19, I tell the attendant, whose eyes meet mine over her mask.
sentences.zh: 我丈夫的COVID-19检测已经呈阳性了，我对服务台的工作人员说，她的目光透过口罩与我相接。

sentences.en: She hands me a mask.
sentences.zh: 她递给我一个口罩。

sentences.en: T's doctor is working at a different clinic today, so we'll see another doctor, and they will compare notes.
sentences.zh: T的医生今天在另一家诊所上班，所以我们要看另一位医生，他们会交换意见。

sentences.en: We wait, wearing our masks.
sentences.zh: 我们戴着口罩等待着。

sentences.en: T's eyes are still closed.
sentences.zh: T的眼睛依然闭着。

sentences.en: I look out the window behind us, where people on the street are walking along as if it were an ordinary day.
sentences.zh: 我看着我们身后的窗户外，街上的人们走来走去，仿佛这是一个平常的日子。

sentences.en: A man opens the door of a tiny cafe across the street with his bare hand and goes inside.
sentences.zh: 街对面一个小咖啡馆的门被一个男人用空手推开，他走了进去。

sentences.en: Another attendant comes to the desk, and the first attendant murmurs quietly to her.
sentences.zh: 另一位工作人员来到服务台，第一位工作人员低声对她耳语了几句。

sentences.en: The second attendant puts on a mask.
sentences.zh: 第二位工作人员戴上了口罩。

sentences.en: We're called inside.
sentences.zh: 我们被叫了进去。

sentences.en: The nurses in masks check T's vitals.
sentences.zh: 戴着口罩的护士检查了T的生命体征。

sentences.en: He has a slight fever, just over 99 degrees, but that may be lowered because of the recent ibuprofen and acetaminophen in his system.
sentences.zh: 他有点低烧，剛好超过99华氏度，但这可能是因为他体内最近用了布洛芬和对乙酰氨基酚而有所降低。

sentences.en: His blood pressure is fine.
sentences.zh: 他的血压很正常。

sentences.en: His pulse is fine.
sentences.zh: 他的脉搏很正常。

sentences.en: His oxygen saturation is fine.
sentences.zh: 他的血氧饱和度很正常。

sentences.en: We tell them about the fevers, the sweats, the nausea, the coughing, the spots of blood he is continuing to cough up, the lower oxygen saturation number we recorded at home
sentences.zh: 我们向他们讲述了发烧、出汗、恶心、咳嗽、他持续咳出的血迹、我们今天早上在家记录到的较低的血氧饱和度数值

sentences.en: this morning.
sentences.zh: 今天早上。

sentences.en: When the nurses leave, T leans back in the examination chair, resting his head with his eyes closed.
sentences.zh: 护士离开后，T靠在检查椅上，闭着眼睛把头靠在上面。

sentences.en: Out in the hall, I hear someone telling a patient that he has been sick for a long time.
sentences.zh: 在走廊里，我听到有人在告诉一个病人，他已经病了很久了。

sentences.en: It's time to go to the hospital five blocks away.
sentences.zh: 是时候去五个街区外的医院了。

sentences.en: The doctor comes in, wearing a mask and a plastic shield over it.
sentences.zh: 医生走了进来，戴着口罩，口罩外面还罩着一个塑料面罩。

sentences.en: T, shivering in a paper gown, follows her out for the x-ray.
sentences.zh: T穿着纸病号服冻得发抖，跟着她出去拍X光片。

sentences.en: That was strangely difficult, he says when he returns, just holding my arms above my head.
sentences.zh: 他说他回来时觉得那出奇地困难，只是把双臂举过头顶。

sentences.en: The x-ray looks different from the one a week ago, the doctor tells us after consulting with the radiologiSt. Now it shows pneumonia in the left lung.
sentences.zh: 医生在咨询过放射科医师后告诉我们，这张X光片看起来和一周前的不一样了。现在显示左肺有肺炎。

sentences.en: T's doctor was right to order the antibiotics last night.
sentences.zh: T的医生昨晚开抗生素是正确的。

sentences.en: T's lungs sound all right when she listens through a stethoscope.
sentences.zh: 当医生用听诊器听时，T的肺部听起来还好。

sentences.en: He is not wheezing.
sentences.zh: 他没有喘鸣。

sentences.en: He is not having breathing probleMs.
sentences.zh: 他没有呼吸问题。

sentences.en: He can keep being treated at home.
sentences.zh: 他可以继续在家接受治疗。

sentences.en: But now we're going to be watching you even more closely, she says.
sentences.zh: 但现在我们要更密切地观察你了，她说。

sentences.en: At the door of the clinic, we stand looking out at two older women chatting outside the doorway, oblivious.
sentences.zh: 在诊所门口，我们站着向外望去，看到两个老妇人在门外聊天，全然不觉。

sentences.en: Do I wave them away?
sentences.zh: 我要挥手让她们走开吗？

sentences.en: Call out that they should get far away, go home, wash their hands, stay inside?
sentences.zh: 大声喊她们赶快离开、回家、洗手、待在室内？

sentences.en: Instead, we just stand there awkwardly until they move on.
sentences.zh: 相反，我们只是尴尬地站在那里，直到她们离开。

sentences.en: Only then do we step outside to begin the long three-block walk home.
sentences.zh: 直到那时，我们才迈出门去，开始漫长地步行三个街区回家。

sentences.en: I point out the early magnolia, the forsythia.
sentences.zh: 我指出了早开的木兰花和连翘。

sentences.en: T says he is cold.
sentences.zh: T说他很冷。

sentences.en: The untrimmed hairs on his neck, under his beard, are white.
sentences.zh: 他脖子上、胡须下面没有修剪的毛发已经白了。

sentences.en: The few people walking past us on the sidewalk don't know that we are visitors from the future.
sentences.zh: 人行道上从我们身边走过的少数人并不知道我们是来自未来的访客。

sentences.en: A vision, a premonition, a walking visitation.
sentences.zh: 一种幻象，一种预感，一个行走的造访者。

sentences.en: This will be them.
sentences.zh: 这就是他们将来的样子。

sentences.en: Either T in the mask, or, if they're lucky, me tending to him.
sentences.zh: 要么是戴着口罩的T，要么，如果他们运气好，就是照顾他的我。

sentences.en: This was recorded by Autumn.
sentences.zh: 这段录音由Autumn录制。

sentences.en: Autumn is an app you can download to listen to lots of audio stories from publishers such as the New York Times.
sentences.zh: Autumn是一款你可以下载的应用程序，用来收听来自《纽约时报》等出版商的大量音频故事。

sentences.en: This week on The Wirecutter Show, we're getting ready for hosting over the holidays.
sentences.zh: 本周的《电线切割机秀》中，我们正在为节日期间的款待做准备。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 收听节目，获取让你的客人在家一样舒适的实用小贴士。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们是那种对光线极度敏感、需要完全黑暗才能入睡的人吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they black out to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们会晕过去才睡觉。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我是说，他们需要什么样的光线环境？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为这是一个非常具体的要求。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有什么过敏症或饮食禁忌吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢喝咖啡还是茶？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.en: Find The Wirecutter Show on the New York Times app or wherever you like to listen.
sentences.zh: 在《纽约时报》应用程序或你喜欢的任何平台上搜索《电线切割机秀》。
